name: Implement Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can use your mythic power to hide magic effects into your implements and trigger them later.

Prerequisite(s): Implement Mastery.

Benefit(s): When using an implement to activate an item mastery or mythic item mastery feat, you can spend a number of mythic power uses equal to the feat’s base Fortitude save bonus prerequisite to place the spell you need into the implement as if using the talismanic implement spell, except this ability works with spells of any level. The selected implement’s mental focus is reduced by 1 per level of the infused spell, including for the purposes of determining the effects of resonant powers.
